articles.summary: Lumexa Imaging (Nasdaq: LMRI), one of the nation’s largest outpatient imaging providers, today announced a new joint venture with Advocate Health to expand its outpatient imaging services in Illinois.
articles.title: Lumexa Imaging Expands Partnership with Advocate Health Through New Illinois Joint Venture

articles.summary: Lumexa Imaging (Nasdaq: LMRI), one of the nation’s largest providers of outpatient imaging services, today reported results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
articles.title: Lumexa Imaging Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Lumexa Imaging (Nasdaq: LMRI), one of the nation’s largest providers of outpatient imaging services, today announced the appointment of Ayis Pyrros, MD, as Chief Clinical Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO).
articles.title: Lumexa Imaging Appoints Dr. Ayis Pyrros as New Chief Clinical Artificial Intelligence Officer

articles.summary: Lumexa Imaging (Nasdaq: LMRI), one of the nation’s largest outpatient imaging providers, today announced the opening of three new outpatient imaging centers in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Texas.
articles.title: LUMEXA IMAGING OPENS THREE NEW IMAGING CENTERS IN NOVEMBER
